gravity.rho_plus_p_today: rho_b + 4*rho_gamma/3 + K*gamma^2 > 0 in the stated ordinary-matter, homogeneous rest-frame branch
gravity.caveat: At n=1 the photon metric coincides with g. Homogeneous vector U=0 and lambda=0 at this epoch. A constant potential or cosmological constant cannot cancel rho+p. Curvature or new gravity changes the equations and requires a new background solution.
